modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cubes-wit: Allows you to play Minecraft in a borderless fullscreen window.
options.letterboxEnabled.tooltip: Render the game at a custom resolution with black bars. Prevents stretching on ultrawide displays.
options.customRenderWidth.tooltip: Internal rendering width (e.g., 2560 for ultrawide). Requires letterbox mode enabled.
options.customRenderHeight.tooltip: Internal rendering height (e.g., 1440). Requires letterbox mode enabled.
